304	def clip_away_from_near(s: dict[str, int], near: dict[str, int] | None) -> dict[str, int]:
305	    if near is None or _is_near_seat(s, near):
306	        return _copy(s)
307	    if not overlaps(s["start_ms"], s["end_ms"], near["start_ms"], near["end_ms"]):
308	        return _copy(s)
309	    if s["start_ms"] >= near["start_ms"] and s["end_ms"] <= near["end_ms"]:
310	        return _seg(s["speaker_index"], s["start_ms"], s["start_ms"])
311	    start = s["start_ms"]
312	    end = s["end_ms"]
313	    if start < near["start_ms"] and end > near["end_ms"]:
314	        start = near["end_ms"]
315	    elif start < near["end_ms"] and end > near["end_ms"]:
316	        start = near["end_ms"]
317	    elif end > near["start_ms"] and start < near["start_ms"]:
318	        end = near["start_ms"]
319	    return _seg(s["speaker_index"], start, end)

322	def _snap_tiny_endpoint(
323	    segs: list[dict[str, int]],
324	    r0: int,
325	    r1: int,
326	    scene: dict[str, Any],
327	    near: dict[str, int] | None,
328	) -> None:
329	    dur = r1 - r0
330	    if dur <= 0 or dur > int(scene["expand_max_region_ms"]):
331	        return
332	    hits = [(i, s) for i, s in enumerate(segs) if overlaps(s["start_ms"], s["end_ms"], r0, r1)]
333	    if len(hits) != 1:
334	        return
335	    ix, s = hits[0]
336	    if _is_near_seat(s, near):
337	        return
338	    cov = overlap_ms(s["start_ms"], s["end_ms"], r0, r1) / float(dur)
339	    if cov < float(scene["expand_if_coverage_below"]):
340	        segs[ix] = _seg(s["speaker_index"], min(s["start_ms"], r0), max(s["end_ms"], r1))
341	
342	
343	def _fill_energy_holes(
344	    segs: list[dict[str, int]],
345	    samples,
346	    hz: int,
347	    scene: dict[str, Any],
348	    near: dict[str, int] | None,
349	    k: int,
350	) -> None:
351	    x = np.asarray(samples, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1)
352	    duration_ms = 0 if hz <= 0 else int(x.size) * 1000 // hz
353	    holes = subtract(0, duration_ms, segs)
354	    orphan_min = int(scene["orphan_min_ms"])
355	    for h0, h1 in holes:
356	        if h1 - h0 < orphan_min:
357	            continue
358	        a = int(np.clip((h0 * hz) // 1000, 0, x.size))
359	        b = int(np.clip((h1 * hz) // 1000, a, x.size))
360	        if b - a < 2:
361	            continue
362	        crop = x[a:b]
363	        for r0, r1 in FF.find_segments(crop, hz):
364	            s0 = h0 + r0 * 1000 // hz
365	            s1 = h0 + r1 * 1000 // hz
366	            adopt(segs, s0, s1, scene, near, k)
367	
368	
369	def _split_non_near_by_vad(
370	    segs: list[dict[str, int]],
371	    vad: list[dict[str, int]],
372	    hz: int,
373	    scene: dict[str, Any],
374	    near: dict[str, int] | None,
375	    k: int,
376	) -> None:
377	    extra: list[tuple[int, int, int]] = []
378	    remove: list[dict[str, int]] = []
379	    for s in segs:
380	        if _is_near_seat(s, near):
381	            continue
382	        hits = []
383	        for r in vad:
384	            r0, r1 = region_ms(r, hz)
385	            if overlaps(s["start_ms"], s["end_ms"], r0, r1):
386	                hits.append(r)
387	        hits.sort(key=lambda r: r["start_sample"])
388	        if len(hits) < 2:
389	            continue
390	        remove.append(s)
391	        first = hits[0]
392	        f0, f1 = region_ms(first, hz)
393	        extra.append((max(s["start_ms"], f0), min(s["end_ms"], f1), s["speaker_index"]))
394	        for h in hits[1:]:
395	            a0, a1 = region_ms(h, hz)
396	            extra.append((max(s["start_ms"], a0), min(s["end_ms"], a1), -1))
397	    remove_ids = {id(s) for s in remove}
398	    kept = [s for s in segs if id(s) not in remove_ids]
399	    segs.clear()
400	    segs.extend(kept)
401	    for a, b, sid in extra:
402	        if sid >= 0 and b > a:
403	            segs.append(_seg(sid, a, b))
404	        else:
405	            adopt(segs, a, b, scene, near, k)
406

408	def run(
409	    vad: list[dict[str, int]],
410	    diar: list[dict[str, int]],
411	    hz: int,
412	    scene: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
413	    samples=None,
414	) -> list[dict[str, int]]:
415	    scene = scene or STAGE6
416	    if int(scene.get("expected_speakers") or 0) <= 0:
417	        return sorted((_copy(s) for s in diar), key=lambda s: s["start_ms"])
418	    k = int(scene["expected_speakers"])
419	    near = min((_copy(s) for s in diar), key=lambda s: s["start_ms"]) if diar else None
420	    segs = [_copy(s) for s in diar]
421	    for region in vad:
422	        r0, r1 = region_ms(region, hz)
423	        for p0, p1 in subtract(r0, r1, segs):
424	            adopt(segs, p0, p1, scene, near, k)
425	        _snap_tiny_endpoint(segs, r0, r1, scene, near)
426	    if samples is not None and np.asarray(samples).size:
427	        _fill_energy_holes(segs, samples, hz, scene, near, k)
428	    _split_non_near_by_vad(segs, vad, hz, scene, near, k)
429	    clipped = []
430	    for s in segs:
431	        c = clip_away_from_near(s, near)
432	        if c["end_ms"] > c["start_ms"]:
433	            clipped.append(c)
434	    capped = cap_to_expected(clipped, k, near)
435	    merged = merge_same_speaker(capped, int(scene["merge_gap_ms"]))
436	    return relabel_by_appearance(merged)

2	"""WER / RTF plus host-side diarization metrics (DER, JER, speaker purity).
3	
4	No pyannote.metrics dependency. Numbers are only as honest as the (ref, hyp)

7	DER: NIST-style (miss + false alarm + speaker error) / reference speaker-time,

9	is counted per speaker (a 20-talker cocktail frame with 20 active refs has
10	weight 20).
11	
12	JER: mean Jaccard error over reference speakers after Hungarian mapping;
13	unmapped hypothesis speakers are extra clusters with JER = 1.

16	a full DER tool is unavailable; we still compute DER here.

34	def tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]:
35	    """Lowercase, fold ё→е, keep comma/period/?/! as tokens, split the rest."""
36	    t = (text or "").lower().replace("ё", "е").replace("Ё", "е")
37	    tokens: list[str] = []
38	    buf: list[str] = []
39	
40	    def flush() -> None:
41	        if buf:
42	            tokens.append("".join(buf))
43	            buf.clear()
44	
45	    for ch in t:
46	        if ch in SCORING_PUNCT:
47	            flush()
48	            tokens.append(ch)
49	        elif ch.isalnum() or ch in "-":
50	            buf.append(ch)
51	        else:
52	            flush()
53	    flush()
54	    return tokens

57	def levenshtein(a: list[str], b: list[str]) -> int:
58	    if not a:
59	        return len(b)
60	    if not b:
61	        return len(a)
62	    prev = list(range(len(b) + 1))
63	    for i, ca in enumerate(a, 1):
64	        cur = [i]
65	        for j, cb in enumerate(b, 1):
66	            ins, delete, sub = cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j] + 1, prev[j - 1] + (ca != cb)
67	            cur.append(min(ins, delete, sub))
68	        prev = cur
69	    return prev[-1]
70

72	def wer(ref: str, hyp: str) -> float | None:
73	    r = tokenize(ref)
74	    if not r:
75	        return None
76	    return levenshtein(r, tokenize(hyp)) / len(r)

86	def wav_duration_ms(path) -> int | None:
87	    from pathlib import Path
88	
89	    try:
90	        data = Path(path).read_bytes()
91	    except OSError:
92	        return None
93	    if len(data) < 44 or data[0:4] != b"RIFF" or data[8:12] != b"WAVE":
94	        return None
95	    pos = 12
96	    sample_rate = bits = channels = None
97	    data_size = None
98	    while pos + 8 <= len(data):
99	        cid = data[pos : pos + 4]
100	        size = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 4 : pos + 8], "little")
101	        body = pos + 8
102	        if cid == b"fmt ":
103	            channels = int.from_bytes(data[body + 2 : body + 4], "little")
104	            sample_rate = int.from_bytes(data[body + 4 : body + 8], "little")
105	            bits = int.from_bytes(data[body + 14 : body + 16], "little")
106	        elif cid == b"data":
107	            data_size = size
108	            break
109	        pos = body + size + (size & 1)
110	    if not all((sample_rate, bits, channels, data_size)):
111	        return None
112	    bytes_per_sec = sample_rate * channels * (bits // 8)
113	    if not bytes_per_sec:
114	        return None
115	    return int(data_size * 1000 / bytes_per_sec)

118	def _hungarian_maximize(weights: list[list[float]]) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
119	    """Maximum-weight assignment. Square-pads with zeros. Pure Python."""
120	    n0 = len(weights)
121	    m0 = len(weights[0]) if weights else 0
122	    n = max(n0, m0)
123	    if n == 0:
124	        return []
125	    wmax = 0.0
126	    for row in weights:
127	        for v in row:
128	            if v > wmax:
129	                wmax = v
130	    cost = [[wmax] * n for _ in range(n)]
131	    for i, row in enumerate(weights):
132	        for j, v in enumerate(row):
133	            cost[i][j] = wmax - v
134	
135	    u = [0.0] * (n + 1)
136	    v = [0.0] * (n + 1)
137	    p = [0] * (n + 1)
138	    way = [0] * (n + 1)
139	    for i in range(1, n + 1):
140	        p[0] = i
141	        minv = [float("inf")] * (n + 1)
142	        used = [False] * (n + 1)
143	        j0 = 0
144	        while True:
145	            used[j0] = True
146	            i0 = p[j0]
147	            delta = float("inf")
148	            j1 = 0
149	            for j in range(1, n + 1):
150	                if used[j]:
151	                    continue
152	                cur = cost[i0 - 1][j - 1] - u[i0] - v[j]
153	                if cur < minv[j]:
154	                    minv[j] = cur
155	                    way[j] = j0
156	                if minv[j] < delta:
157	                    delta = minv[j]
158	                    j1 = j
159	            for j in range(n + 1):
160	                if used[j]:
161	                    u[p[j]] += delta
162	                    v[j] -= delta
163	                else:
164	                    minv[j] -= delta
165	            j0 = j1
166	            if p[j0] == 0:
167	                break
168	        while True:
169	            j1 = way[j0]
170	            p[j0] = p[j1]
171	            j0 = j1
172	            if j0 == 0:
173	                break
174	    pairs = []
175	    for j in range(1, n + 1):
176	        i = p[j]
177	        if i <= n0 and j <= m0:
178	            pairs.append((i - 1, j - 1))
179	    return pairs
180

183	    out = []

186	        if not sid:

204	def _collar_mask(ref: list[tuple[int, int, str]], n_frames: int, frame_ms: int, collar_ms: int) -> list[bool]:
205	    """True = evaluate this frame. False = inside collar of a ref boundary."""
206	    if collar_ms <= 0:
207	        return [True] * n_frames
208	    c = collar_ms
209	    bounds = []
210	    for s, e, _sid in ref:
211	        bounds.append(s)
212	        bounds.append(e)
213	    eval_ok = [True] * n_frames
214	    for b in bounds:
215	        lo = max(0, b - c)
216	        hi = b + c
217	        a = lo // frame_ms
218	        z = min(n_frames, (hi + frame_ms - 1) // frame_ms)
219	        for i in range(a, z):
220	            eval_ok[i] = False
221	    return eval_ok

224	def _frame_sets(
225	    segs: list[tuple[int, int, str]], n_frames: int, frame_ms: int
226	) -> list[set[str]]:
227	    frames: list[set[str]] = [set() for _ in range(n_frames)]
228	    for s, e, sid in segs:
229	        a = max(0, s // frame_ms)
230	        z = min(n_frames, (e + frame_ms - 1) // frame_ms)
231	        for i in range(a, z):
232	            frames[i].add(sid)
233	    return frames

12	/**
13	 * Single-channel **DEMO_STAGE6** prep (offline ViewModel path only — not Path B).
14	 * CLIPPED/BAD_MIC/empty on **raw** PCM (hard), then frozen per-turn gain
15	 * (do not retune), then **phone-distance EQ** on far islands only (near seat
16	 * identity). Inspect as bound main: SOFT_LOW / soft BAND_LIMITED,
17	 * **never hard-drop distant talkers**.
18	 */
19	object DemoPcmPrep {
20	    fun prepare(audio: PcmAudio, boundMain: Boolean = true): PreparedDemoPcm {
21	        val s16 = Pcm.floatToS16le(audio.samples)
22	        val rawGate = StreamPcmGate.inspect(s16, audio.sampleRate, boundSeat = boundMain)
23	        val hard = hardSkipCode(rawGate)
24	        if (hard != null) {
25	            return PreparedDemoPcm(
26	                audio = audio,
27	                skipAsr = true,
28	                skipCode = hard,
29	                rawGate = rawGate,
30	                afterGate = rawGate,
31	                gain = FarFieldGain.stage(FloatArray(0)),
32	                eq = PhoneDistanceEq.apply(FloatArray(0)),
33	            )
34	        }
35	        val gain = FarFieldGain.stage(audio.samples)
36	        val eq = PhoneDistanceEq.apply(gain.samples)
37	        val afterGate = StreamPcmGate.inspect(
38	            Pcm.floatToS16le(eq.samples),
39	            audio.sampleRate,
40	            boundSeat = boundMain,
41	        )
42	        return PreparedDemoPcm(
43	            audio = PcmAudio(eq.samples, audio.sampleRate, audio.sourceName),
44	            skipAsr = false,
45	            skipCode = null,
46	            rawGate = rawGate,
47	            afterGate = afterGate,
48	            gain = gain,
49	            eq = eq,
50	        )
51	    }
52	
53	    private fun hardSkipCode(stats: StreamPcmStats): String? {
54	        val code = stats.rejectCode ?: return null
55	        return when (code) {
56	            PresentConnectCodes.CLIPPED,
57	            PresentConnectCodes.BAD_MIC,
58	            -> code
59	            PresentConnectCodes.LOW_ENERGY -> if (stats.n == 0) code else null
60	            else -> null
61	        }
62	    }
63	}

49	    fun stagePerSegment(samples: FloatArray, sampleRateHz: Int = SAMPLE_RATE_HZ): FarFieldGainResult {
50	        val n = samples.size
51	        val rmsBefore = rms(samples)

116	        val capped = min(desired, min(peakCap, maxGainLinear))
117	        return if (capped < 1.0) 1.0 else capped

1	package team.mikcoders.neurosteno.llm
2	
3	import dev.ffmpegkit.llama.Llama
4	import dev.ffmpegkit.llama.LlamaConfig
5	import java.io.File
6	
7	/** Tiny on-device GGUF completion. No cloud. */
8	interface OnDeviceLlmRunner {
9	    val engineName: String
10	    val ready: Boolean
11	    suspend fun complete(system: String, user: String): String
12	}
13	
14	/**
15	 * llama.cpp JNI via `dev.ffmpegkit-maintained:llama-android` (GGUF, arm64).
16	 * Loads [gguf] from filesDir/models/llm (Platform unpack; we do not pack assets).
17	 */
18	class LlamaCppGgufRunner(
19	    private val gguf: File,
20	    private val contextSize: Int = 1_024,
21	    private val threads: Int = 2,
22	    private val maxTokens: Int = 96,
23	) : OnDeviceLlmRunner {
24	    override val engineName: String = "llama.cpp GGUF ${gguf.name}"
25	
26	    @Volatile override var ready: Boolean = false
27	        private set
28	
29	    @Volatile private var session: (suspend (String, String) -> String)? = null
30	
31	    override suspend fun complete(system: String, user: String): String {
32	        val run = session ?: openSession()
33	        return run(system, user)
34	    }
35	
36	    private suspend fun openSession(): suspend (String, String) -> String {
37	        require(gguf.isFile && gguf.length() > 0L) { "GGUF missing: ${gguf.path}" }
38	        val model = Llama.loadModel(
39	            modelPath = gguf.absolutePath,
40	            config = LlamaConfig(contextSize = contextSize, threads = threads),
41	        )
42	        val fn: suspend (String, String) -> String = { sys, usr ->
43	            Llama.complete(
44	                model,
45	                prompt = usr,
46	                systemPrompt = sys,
47	                maxTokens = maxTokens,
48	            ).text.trim()
49	        }
50	        session = fn
51	        ready = true
52	        return fn
53	    }
54	}
55	
56	/** Test double — still the GGUF post-pass path, not identity. */
57	class ScriptedLlmRunner(
58	    private val replies: (String) -> String,
59	    override val engineName: String = "llama.cpp GGUF scripted",
60	) : OnDeviceLlmRunner {
61	    override val ready: Boolean = true
62	    override suspend fun complete(system: String, user: String): String = replies(user)
63	}

14	/**

18	 * the LLM then arrives via scripts/download-models.sh + adb push.

20	val embedLlm: Boolean = (findProperty("embedLlm")?.toString() ?: "false") == "true"
21	
22	val judgeModelRelPaths = mutableListOf(
23	    "asr/zipformer-ru-int8/encoder.int8.onnx",
24	    "asr/zipformer-ru-int8/decoder.onnx",
25	    "asr/zipformer-ru-int8/joiner.int8.onnx",
26	    "asr/zipformer-ru-int8/tokens.txt",

32	
33	fun resolveJudgeModel(rel: String): File {
34	    val direct = File(modelsSrc, rel)
35	    if (direct.isFile) return direct
36	    if (rel.endsWith("embedding.onnx")) {
37	        val alt = File(modelsSrc, "diar/3dspeaker_speech_eres2net_base_sv_zh-cn_3dspeaker_16k.onnx")
38	        if (alt.isFile) return alt
39	    }
40	    if (rel.endsWith("segmentation.onnx")) {
41	        val alt = File(modelsSrc, "diar/model.onnx")
42	        if (alt.isFile) return alt
43	        val nested = File(modelsSrc, "diar/sherpa-onnx-pyannote-segmentation-3-0/model.onnx")
44	        if (nested.isFile) return nested
45	    }
46	    return direct
47	}

49	val prepareEmbeddedModels by tasks.registering {
50	    group = "build"
51	    description = "Copy Zipformer-ru + Silero VAD + diar ONNX (and, with -PembedLlm, the GGUF) into judge APK assets/models"
52	    outputs.dir(embeddedModelsAssets)
53	    // Without declared inputs Gradle marks this up-to-date forever, and the
54	    // APK silently ships whatever weights the first build found. Measured the
55	    // hard way: a replaced pyannote segmentation stayed stale inside a
56	    // "successful" assemble.
57	    judgeModelRelPaths.forEach { rel ->
58	        val src = resolveJudgeModel(rel)
59	        if (src.isFile) {
60	            inputs.file(src)

62	            inputs.property("absent:$rel", true)

65	    inputs.property("embedLlm", embedLlm)

68	        if (missing.isNotEmpty()) {

70	            require(script.isFile) { "missing $script and models $missing" }
71	            exec {
72	                commandLine("bash", script.absolutePath)
73	                workingDir(repoRoot)
74	            }
75	            missing = judgeModelRelPaths.filter { !resolveJudgeModel(it).isFile }
76	        }
77	        require(missing.isEmpty()) { "judge models missing after download: $missing" }
78	        val destRoot = embeddedModelsAssets.get().asFile.resolve("models")
79	        destRoot.deleteRecursively()
80	        for (rel in judgeModelRelPaths) {
81	            val src = resolveJudgeModel(rel)

83	            dest.parentFile.mkdirs()

#### Thinking

**Evaluating beam search and benchmarking**

I’m considering how beam search operates, particularly comparing a greedy approach that will only track one path versus a four-path approach. I should test options like full excerpts with and without padding, and incorporate different penalty settings. Writing a benchmark script that’s reproducible is essential, as it will allow me to gather metrics in JSON format. This could serve as a useful deliverable. Additionally, it’s important to maintain consistent intonation and punctuation throughout the process to ensure accurate results.

6	/**
7	 * On-device LLM post-pass (Hex.Team TZ «локальная LLM»).
8	 *
9	 * Identity / heuristic-only **fails** the brief. Tiny GGUF
10	 * (Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct Q4_0) is loaded from filesDir/models/llm/. That tree is
11	 * filled either by `AssetModelUnpack` when the APK was built with
12	 * `-PembedLlm=true` (the hand-in check APK) or by
13	 * `scripts/download-models.sh` + adb push during development. llama.cpp only
14	 * adds spoken-intonation punct ([IntonationPunct]): Zipformer emits NONE.
15	 */
16	interface LocalLlmPostPass {
17	    val weightsPresent: Boolean
18	    val isOnDeviceLlm: Boolean
19	    val displayName: String
20	
21	    suspend fun cleanup(utterances: List<Utterance>): List<Utterance>
22	}
23	
24	class IdentityLlmPostPass : LocalLlmPostPass {
25	    override val weightsPresent: Boolean = false
26	    override val isOnDeviceLlm: Boolean = false
27	    override val displayName: String = "llm-identity"
28	
29	    override suspend fun cleanup(utterances: List<Utterance>): List<Utterance> = utterances
30	}
31	
32	/**
33	 * Intonation-safe punct when GGUF is absent. **Not** the check-APK LLM.
34	 * Must not strip hyp punctuation or rewrite commas.
35	 */
36	class HeuristicPunctuationPostPass : LocalLlmPostPass {
37	    override val weightsPresent: Boolean = false
38	    override val isOnDeviceLlm: Boolean = false
39	    override val displayName: String = "llm-weights-missing (intonation punct only)"
40	
41	    override suspend fun cleanup(utterances: List<Utterance>): List<Utterance> =
42	        applyIntonation(utterances)
43	
44	    companion object {
45	        fun punctuate(raw: String, nextGapMs: Long = Long.MAX_VALUE): String =
46	            IntonationPunct.apply(raw, candidate = null, nextGapMs = nextGapMs)
47	
48	        fun applyIntonation(utterances: List<Utterance>): List<Utterance> =
49	            utterances.mapIndexed { i, u ->
50	                val nextGap = if (i + 1 < utterances.size) {
51	                    (utterances[i + 1].startMs - u.endMs).coerceAtLeast(0L)
52	                } else {
53	                    Long.MAX_VALUE
54	                }
55	                u.copy(text = IntonationPunct.apply(u.text, nextGapMs = nextGap))
56	            }
57	    }
58	}
59	
60	class MissingWeightsLlmPostPass : LocalLlmPostPass by HeuristicPunctuationPostPass()
61	
62	/**
63	 * Real tiny GGUF via llama.cpp. Prompt asks only for spoken-intonation punct.
64	 * Output is merged with [IntonationPunct] so the model cannot strip marks or
65	 * rewrite commas to textbook placement.
66	 */
67	class GgufLlmPostPass(
68	    private val gguf: File,
69	    private val runner: OnDeviceLlmRunner,
70	) : LocalLlmPostPass {
71	    override val weightsPresent: Boolean = gguf.isFile && gguf.length() > 0L
72	    override val isOnDeviceLlm: Boolean = true
73	    override val displayName: String = runner.engineName
74	
75	    override suspend fun cleanup(utterances: List<Utterance>): List<Utterance> {
76	        if (!weightsPresent) {
77	            return HeuristicPunctuationPostPass.applyIntonation(utterances)
78	        }
79	        return utterances.mapIndexed { i, u ->
80	            val nextGap = if (i + 1 < utterances.size) {
81	                (utterances[i + 1].startMs - u.endMs).coerceAtLeast(0L)
82	            } else {
83	                Long.MAX_VALUE
84	            }
85	            val candidate = try {
86	                runner.complete(SYSTEM, userPrompt(u.text, nextGap))
87	            } catch (_: Throwable) {
88	                null
89	            }
90	            u.copy(text = IntonationPunct.apply(u.text, candidate, nextGap))
91	        }
92	    }
93	
94	    companion object {
95	        const val SYSTEM =
96	            "ASR (Zipformer) не ставит знаки. ДОБАВЬ пунктуацию устной речи: запятые, точки, ? !. " +
97	                "Запятая = пауза/интонация говорящего, не школьное правило. " +
98	                "НЕ удаляй уже стоящие знаки. НЕ переставляй чужие запятые. " +
99	                "Не меняй слова. ё и е — один звук, пиши е. Верни только исправленную реплику."
100	
101	        fun userPrompt(text: String, nextGapMs: Long): String =
102	            "Пауза после реплики: ${nextGapMs.coerceAtMost(10_000L)} мс.\nРеплика: $text"
103	    }
104	}
105	
106	object LlmPostPassFactory {
107	    fun create(gguf: File?, runner: OnDeviceLlmRunner? = null): LocalLlmPostPass {
108	        if (gguf != null && gguf.isFile && gguf.length() > 0L) {
109	            return GgufLlmPostPass(gguf, runner ?: LlamaCppGgufRunner(gguf))
110	        }
111	        return MissingWeightsLlmPostPass()
112	    }
113	}

Cancellation is observed between\n * calls; eviction/close wait for the owning transaction before freeing JNI.\n * Creation and destruction stay on [dispatcher], including teardown after the\n * caller is cancelled. A failed transaction invalidates possibly poisoned state.\n */\ninternal class InferenceSession<M : Any>(\n    private val create: suspend () -> M,\n    private val destroy: (M) -> Unit,\n    private val dispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.Default,\n) {\n    private val mutex = Mutex()\n    private val closed = AtomicBoolean(false)\n    private var model: M? = null\n\n    /** [getModel] is valid only inside the transaction and must not escape it. */\n    suspend fun <T> run(operation: suspend (getModel: suspend () -> M) -> T): T =\n        withContext(dispatcher) {\n            mutex.withLock {\n                check(!closed.get()) { \"Inference session is closed\" }\n                try {\n                    currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()\n                    val result = operation {\n                        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()\n                        // Publish ownership before observing cancellation of a\n                        // suspending native load, so its handle is not lost.\n                        val loaded = model ?: withContext(NonCancellable) { create() }\n                            .also { model = it }\n                        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()\n                        loaded\n                    }\n                    currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()\n                    result\n                } catch (failure: Throwable) {\n                    try {\n                        discard()\n                    } catch (cleanup: Throwable) {\n                        failure.addSuppressed(cleanup)\n                    }\n                    throw failure\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n    /** Drop warm weights under memory pressure; the next transaction may reload. */\n    suspend fun evict() = withContext(dispatcher + NonCancellable) {\n        mutex.withLock { discard() }\n    }\n\n    /** Reject queued/new work and release once the active transaction finishes. */\n    suspend fun close() {\n        closed.set(true)\n        withContext(dispatcher + NonCancellable) {\n            mutex.withLock { discard() }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private fun discard() {\n        val old = model\n        model = null\n        if (old != null) destroy(old)\n    }\n}\n"

+## Владение native-сессиями
+
+`InferenceSession` держит один ленивый ASR recognizer на pipeline; каждый
+crop создаёт новый stream. Mutex сериализует полную транзакцию, включая LLM,
+а `Dispatchers.Default` не допускает native-инференс на UI-потоке. Gain/EQ,
+VAD, speaker reconciliation, crop padding и greedy decoder не изменены.
+
+На холодном пути segmentation/embedding освобождаются до создания ASR.
+На повторном пути ASR остаётся тёплым; это обмен памяти на отсутствие повторной
+инициализации. `StenoViewModel` передаёт memory-pressure/UI-hidden события в
+`trimMemory()`; ASR/GGUF освобождаются между транзакциями. `onCleared()` запускает
+закрытие вне отменённого `viewModelScope`. JNI не прерывается посередине:
+отмена проверяется между вызовами, а close/eviction ждут владельца. Неуспешная
+транзакция сбрасывает потенциально повреждённую native-сессию. Кэша результатов
+распознавания нет.
+
+Хостовый ASR-only микробенчмарк на шести неизменённых excerpts:
+1852.666 → 603.816 мс при повторном использовании модели, **3.068×**, точное
+совпадение текста/tokens/timestamps. Это не скорость всего pipeline/телефона.
+Методика, отрицательный результат beam-search и ограничения:
+[TEST_RESULTS.md](TEST_RESULTS.md#runtime-повторное-использование-native-сессий-2026-11-07).
+

+## Runtime: повторное использование native-сессий (2026-11-07)
+
+Изменение относительно `8eb4bb5`: один лениво загружаемый ASR-распознаватель
+на pipeline, новые stream-объекты на каждый crop. `InferenceSession` сериализует
+весь вызов; DSP и native-инференс выполняются вне UI-потока. На холодном пути
+сессии diarization освобождаются **до** создания ASR. GGUF тоже имеет
+сериализованное владение и явный `Llama.releaseModel`. При memory pressure
+кэши весов очищаются между транзакциями; закрытие ждёт активного вызова JNI.
+Отмена не проглатывается LLM-фолбэком. Кэша готовых расшифровок нет.
+
+**Область замера ограничена:** Windows host, sherpa-onnx Python 2.0.1, CPU,
+2 потока, 5 повторов с чередованием cold/warm, один живой recognizer в каждом
+условии. Вход — шесть закоммиченных mix-excerpts из `artifacts/demo-stage6-handoff/`
+с известными границами, суммарно 40.068 с (включая повторяющиеся 200 мс перекрытия).
+Полного `DEMO_STAGE6.wav` здесь нет. Это **не** новая строка полного frozen gate,
+не Android RTF и не end-to-end latency. Никакой diarization/LLM в этом
+микробенчмарке нет; к PCM не добавлялись gain/EQ. Cold = создание новых ONNX
+сессий, а не сброшенный файловый кэш ОС или первый запуск APK.
+
+| ASR lifecycle | медиана, мс |
+|---|---:|
+| новый recognizer + decode всех шести excerpts | 1852.666 |
+| прогретый recognizer + новый decode тех же excerpts | 603.816 |
+| отношение cold/warm | **3.068×** |
+
+Текст, tokens и timestamps совпали точно во всех проверках. SHA-256 каждого
+входа, четырёх ASR-файлов и скрипта, отдельные времена всех повторов и гипотезы:
+[`asr-runtime.json`](../artifacts/optimization/asr-runtime.json).
+
+Альтернатива **не принята**: `modified_beam_search`, 4 пути — те же **35/68**
+ошибок, что у greedy, при 687.850 против 600.619 мс median decode (+14.5%).
+Пунктуация включена в 68 ref-токенов, `ё→е`; гипотезы в этом ASR-only замере
+без LLM-пунктуации. Это диагностический oracle-crop WER, не качество полной
+комнаты и не восстановление speaker_5. Production остаётся greedy.
+
+Проверки после изменения:
+
+- **126 JVM-тестов / 21 класс на каждом flavor**, 0 failures/errors/skips;
+  новые тесты проверяют dispatcher, lazy reuse, конкурентных клиентов,
+  отмену во время загрузки, отказ/повтор загрузки, eviction/close при активном
+  владельце, отмену самого close и прохождение LLM-cancellation.
+- **61 + 18** Python-тестов — OK. Веса, frozen gain/EQ/VAD, gold и строки gate
+  не изменялись. Сигнальный путь и параметры ASR остались прежними.
+- Собраны `stenographerDebug -PembedLlm=true` и `presentConnectSlim`.
+  Новый локальный check-APK: `apk/app-stenographer-runtime-embedLlm.apk`,
+  573 498 719 B, SHA-256 `f80d8ab14ed5fc7d2f5612b3448b562dad0a88835aab5cc6fa574e5fccb6b377`.
+  Проверены v2-подпись, наличие `InferenceSession` в DEX и SHA-256 **8/8**
+  модельных ассетов против локальных весов. APK в git не добавляется.
+- [`verification.json`](../artifacts/optimization/verification.json) хранит
+  команды, счётчики тестов, hashes APK и границы проверки.
+
+Телефона по `adb devices` нет. Native GGUF, Android RAM/энергопотребление,
+первый запуск и скорость всего pipeline **не измерены**; 3.068× нельзя
+выдавать за ускорение всего приложения или телефона. Сессии экономят повторную
+инициализацию ценой удержания весов до eviction/close. Новый локальный APK
+не заменяет ранее опубликованные release assets автоматически.
+
+Воспроизведение (из корня; `sherpa-onnx==2.0.1`, `numpy`):
+
+```bash
+python scripts/benchmark_asr_runtime.py --repeats 5 --out artifacts/optimization/asr-runtime.json
+```

8	/** Tiny on-device GGUF completion. No cloud. */
9	interface OnDeviceLlmRunner {
10	    val engineName: String
11	    val ready: Boolean
12	    suspend fun complete(system: String, user: String): String
13	    suspend fun trimMemory() {}
14	    suspend fun close() {}
15	}
16	
17	/**
18	 * llama.cpp JNI via `dev.ffmpegkit-maintained:llama-android` (GGUF, arm64).
19	 * Loads [gguf] from filesDir/models/llm (Platform unpack; we do not pack assets).
20	 */
21	class LlamaCppGgufRunner(
22	    private val gguf: File,
23	    private val contextSize: Int = 1_024,
24	    private val threads: Int = 2,
25	    private val maxTokens: Int = 96,
26	) : OnDeviceLlmRunner {
27	    override val engineName: String = "llama.cpp GGUF ${gguf.name}"
28	
29	    @Volatile override var ready: Boolean = false
30	        private set
31	
32	    private val session = InferenceSession(
33	        create = {
34	            require(gguf.isFile && gguf.length() > 0L) { "GGUF missing: ${gguf.path}" }
35	            Llama.loadModel(
36	                modelPath = gguf.absolutePath,
37	                config = LlamaConfig(contextSize = contextSize, threads = threads),
38	            ).also { ready = true }
39	        },
40	        destroy = { model ->
41	            ready = false
42	            Llama.releaseModel(model)
43	        },
44	    )
45	
46	    override suspend fun complete(system: String, user: String): String =
47	        session.run { getModel ->
48	            Llama.complete(
49	                getModel(),
50	                prompt = user,
51	                systemPrompt = system,
52	                maxTokens = maxTokens,
53	            ).text.trim()
54	        }
55	
56	    override suspend fun trimMemory() = session.evict()
57	
58	    override suspend fun close() = session.close()
59	}
60	
61	/** Test double — still the GGUF post-pass path, not identity. */
62	class ScriptedLlmRunner(
63	    private val replies: (String) -> String,
64	    override val engineName: String = "llama.cpp GGUF scripted",
65	) : OnDeviceLlmRunner {
66	    override val ready: Boolean = true
67	    override suspend fun complete(system: String, user: String): String = replies(user)

1	package team.mikcoders.neurosteno.pipeline
2	
3	import java.io.File
4	import java.io.InputStream
5	
6	/**
7	 * Copy judge-APK assets/models into filesDir/models on first launch.
8	 * sherpa-onnx needs filesystem paths; assets alone are not enough at inference.
9	 * download-models.sh / adb-push is not the judge path.
10	 */
11	object AssetModelUnpack {
12	    const val ASSET_ROOT = "models"
13	    const val MARKER = ".unpacked"
14	
15	    val REQUIRED: List<String> = listOf(
16	        "asr/zipformer-ru-int8/encoder.int8.onnx",
17	        "asr/zipformer-ru-int8/decoder.onnx",
18	        "asr/zipformer-ru-int8/joiner.int8.onnx",
19	        "asr/zipformer-ru-int8/tokens.txt",
20	        "vad/silero_vad.onnx",
21	        "diar/segmentation.onnx",
22	        "diar/embedding.onnx",
23	    )
24	
25	    /**
26	     * Packed only when the build ran with `-PembedLlm=true` (the 353 MB Qwen2
27	     * GGUF roughly doubles the APK). The TZ requires a local LLM, so the
28	     * hand-in APK is built with it; an APK without it still does
29	     * ASR + VAD + diarization and falls back to intonation-punct only.
30	     * Absent optional assets are never reported as `missing`.
31	     */
32	    val OPTIONAL: List<String> = listOf(
33	        "llm/qwen2-0_5b-instruct-q4_0.gguf",
34	    )
35	
36	    data class Report(
37	        val copied: Int,
38	        val skippedExisting: Int,
39	        val missing: List<String>,
40	        val ready: Boolean,
41	        val optionalCopied: Int = 0,
42	    )
43	
44	    fun needed(destRoot: File, assetExists: (String) -> Boolean = { false }): Boolean {
45	        if (!File(destRoot, MARKER).isFile) return true
46	        val requiredMissing = REQUIRED.any { rel ->
47	            val f = File(destRoot, rel)
48	            !f.isFile || f.length() <= 0L
49	        }
50	        if (requiredMissing) return true
51	        // A newer APK that starts shipping the GGUF must still land on a phone
52	        // that already unpacked the ASR/VAD/diar set.
53	        return OPTIONAL.any { rel ->
54	            assetExists("$ASSET_ROOT/$rel") && !File(destRoot, rel).isFile
55	        }
56	    }
57	
58	    fun unpack(destRoot: File, openAsset: (String) -> InputStream?): Report {
59	        destRoot.mkdirs()
60	        var copied = 0
61	        var skipped = 0
62	        val missing = ArrayList<String>()
63	        for (rel in REQUIRED) {
64	            val dest = File(destRoot, rel)
65	            if (dest.isFile && dest.length() > 0L) {
66	                skipped++
67	                continue
68	            }
69	            val input = openAsset("$ASSET_ROOT/$rel")
70	            if (input == null) {
71	                missing += rel
72	                continue
73	            }
74	            dest.parentFile?.mkdirs()
75	            input.use { ins -> dest.outputStream().use { outs -> ins.copyTo(outs) } }
76	            copied++
77	        }
78	        var optionalCopied = 0
79	        for (rel in OPTIONAL) {
80	            val dest = File(destRoot, rel)
81	            if (dest.isFile && dest.length() > 0L) continue
82	            val input = openAsset("$ASSET_ROOT/$rel") ?: continue
83	            dest.parentFile?.mkdirs()
84	            input.use { ins -> dest.outputStream().use { outs -> ins.copyTo(outs) } }
85	            optionalCopied++
86	        }
87	        val ready = REQUIRED.all { rel ->
88	            val f = File(destRoot, rel)
89	            f.isFile && f.length() > 0L
90	        }
91	        if (ready) {
92	            File(destRoot, MARKER).writeText("neurosteno-embedded-models\n")
93	        }
94	        return Report(
95	            copied = copied,
96	            skippedExisting = skipped,
97	            missing = missing,
98	            ready = ready,
99	            optionalCopied = optionalCopied,
100	        )
101	    }
102	}

36	            return ModelStore.whisperFile(dir, "encoder") != null &&
37	                ModelStore.whisperFile(dir, "decoder") != null &&
38	                ModelStore.whisperFile(dir, "tokens") != null
39	        }
40	    val hasEmergencyAsr: Boolean get() = voskDir != null
41	    val hasLlm: Boolean get() = llmGguf != null
42	
43	    val readyForOfflineDemo: Boolean get() = hasPrimaryAsr && hasVad && hasDiar
44	}
45	
46	class ModelStore(private val context: Context) {
47	    fun modelsDir(): File = File(context.filesDir, "models")
48	
49	    /**
50	     * First-launch copy of the weights packed into the judge APK
51	     * (Platform PR #3 @ af71d91). No-op on the slim build or when filesDir
52	     * already holds the packs, so an adb-pushed models/ tree still wins.
53	     */
54	    fun ensureUnpacked(): AssetModelUnpack.Report? {
55	        if (!BuildConfig.EMBEDDED_MODELS) return null
56	        val dest = modelsDir()
57	        if (!AssetModelUnpack.needed(dest, ::assetExists)) {
58	            return AssetModelUnpack.Report(
59	                copied = 0,
60	                skippedExisting = AssetModelUnpack.REQUIRED.size,
61	                missing = emptyList(),
62	                ready = true,
63	            )
64	        }
65	        val report = AssetModelUnpack.unpack(dest) { assetPath ->
66	            try {
67	                context.assets.open(assetPath)
68	            } catch (_: IOException) {
69	                null
70	            }
71	        }
72	        if (!report.ready) {
73	            Log.e(TAG, "embedded models incomplete missing=${report.missing}")
74	        } else {
75	            Log.i(
76	                TAG,
77	                "embedded models ready copied=${report.copied} skipped=${report.skippedExisting} llmPacked=${report.optionalCopied}",
78	            )
79	        }
80	        return report
81	    }
82	
83	    /** Assets live under assets/models/…; a missing dir or file is not an error. */
84	    private fun assetExists(path: String): Boolean {
85	        val slash = path.lastIndexOf('/')
86	        val dir = if (slash >= 0) path.substring(0, slash) else ""
87	        val name = if (slash >= 0) path.substring(slash + 1) else path
88	        return runCatching { context.assets.list(dir)?.contains(name) == true }.getOrDefault(false)
89	    }
90	
91	    fun resolve(): ModelPaths {
92	        val root = modelsDir()
93	        return ModelPaths(
94	            zipformerDir = dirIfExists(File(root, "asr/zipformer-ru-int8")),
95	            whisperTinyDir = dirIfExists(File(root, "asr/whisper-tiny")),
96	            sileroVad = firstExisting(
97	                File(root, "vad/silero_vad.onnx"),
98	                File(root, "vad/silero_vad.int8.onnx"),
99	            ),
100	            diarSegmentation = firstExisting(
101	                File(root, "diar/segmentation.onnx"),
102	                File(root, "diar/model.onnx"),
103	            ),
104	            diarEmbedding = firstExisting(
105	                File(root, "diar/embedding.onnx"),
106	                File(root, "diar/3dspeaker_speech_eres2net_base_sv_zh-cn_3dspeaker_16k.onnx"),
107	            ),
108	            voskDir = dirIfExists(File(root, "vosk-small-ru")),
109	            llmGguf = root.resolve("llm").listFiles()?.firstOrNull { it.extension == "gguf" },
110	        )
111	    }
112	
113	    companion object {
114	        private const val TAG = "ModelStore"
115	
116	        fun dirIfExists(dir: File): File? = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory && it.list()?.isNotEmpty() == true }
117	
118	        fun firstExisting(vararg files: File): File? = files.firstOrNull { it.isFile }
119	
120	        fun zipformerFile(dir: File, kind: String): File? {
121	            val names = dir.listFiles() ?: return null
122	            return names.firstOrNull { f ->
123	                val n = f.name.lowercase()
124	                when (kind) {
125	                    "tokens.txt" -> n == "tokens.txt"
126	                    "encoder" -> n.contains("encoder") && n.endsWith(".onnx")
127	                    "decoder" -> n.contains("decoder") && n.endsWith(".onnx")
128	                    "joiner" -> n.contains("joiner") && n.endsWith(".onnx")
129	                    else -> false
130	                }
131	            }
132	        }
133	
134	        fun whisperFile(dir: File, kind: String): File? {
135	            val names = dir.listFiles() ?: return null
136	            return names.firstOrNull { f ->
137	                val n = f.name.lowercase()
138	                when (kind) {
139	                    "tokens" -> n.endsWith("tokens.txt")
140	                    "encoder" -> n.contains("encoder") && n.endsWith(".onnx")
141	                    "decoder" -> n.contains("decoder") && n.endsWith(".onnx")
142	                    else -> false
143	                }
144	            }
145	        }
146	    }
147	}

#### Thinking

**Considering model configuration**

I'm looking into the basic configuration options for JNI, such as topK, topP, and temperature settings. It might be interesting to design a tool that allows an LLM to generate an edit script focused on punctuation — perhaps one token for each gap in the text. Still, I need to weigh the costs associated with using the native model, especially since outputting a full vocabulary of 151k can be quite significant.

#### Thinking

**Evaluating graph optimization**

I’m considering the original graph size of 70MB versus the optimized graph, which is about 67MB but contains around 2400 nodes. There's a significant difference in initialization time—down from 1.2 seconds to 0.2 seconds—which makes me wonder about the implications. I'm also thinking if the pre-packed caches might be serialized, and if the ORT format, used by Sherpa, helps in achieving a smaller file size with `CreateSession`.**Considering script functionality**

I'm thinking about how the script `scripts/compact_models.py` performs lossless zipping and runs ORT basic optimization as the user requested. It seems important to keep it within the user's scope without needing external downloads, as long as modern tooling is sufficient. I realize that batch profiling can be costly, and I need to work independently from any model downloads since those aren’t allowed. I should also avoid using subagents for this task.

The 573.5 MB APK contains **353 MB of LLM weights, 119 MB of speech models, 58 MB of DEX code, and 41 MB of compressed native libraries**.

The first cuts can preserve model quality exactly: shrink the release code, ship ARM64 only—the LLM already requires it—and compress the bundled weights losslessly. I also found that **145 MB of the “Q4” LLM is actually one Q8 embedding table**; that’s a focused quantization candidate, but it needs its own quality test before adoption.

#### Thinking

**Evaluating optimization parameters**

I'm focusing on optimizing the baseline, aiming for a 0.6MB savings with a start time of 2.49 seconds compared to the previous session graph baseline. I need to benchmark two recognizers that aren't running concurrently, ensuring a valid start gate. My goal is to isolate the script, targeting stability in the artifacts, eliminating any shell interactions and handwritten processes, so everything is reproducible at the end.

**Creating benchmark scripts**

I'm working on a script called `measure_compact_models.py`, which will handle `--prepare-onnx` and benchmarking tasks. It includes baseline models and optimizes the encoder by copying the input and output. The native effects of the models will be compared across five cycles. I’ll prepare for decoding ASR crops and expand fixed inputs for demo stages while monitoring peak memory usage for each process without unnecessary delays. I’ll ensure everything is properly documented for clarity!

**Analyzing memory usage for optimization**

I'm evaluating peak memory usage using `GetProcessMemoryInfo` and comparing it with `psutil.memory_info().peak_wset`. I need to check memory fields for LLAMA using the `llama-bench -ojson` command to analyze the model's parameters and memory footprint closely. Improving init times through offline graph optimization could reduce initialization from 1300ms to 100ms, which would be fantastic! I’ll also consider testing an ONNX optimized format to potentially lower memory size while maintaining performance for better efficiency.

#### Thinking

**Evaluating file compression**

I'm considering the best compression method, especially with LZMA versus ZIP. Using xz preset 6 seems to offer about a 20% size reduction, which is promising. However, relying on LZMA for Android adds overhead, increasing startup time and memory usage, which may not be ideal for user experience. Plus, cross-ABI support is limited to arm64, which leads to quality loss with other ABIs. Ultimately, I need to deliver something that balances compression with performance.

The broader Zipformer check passed on **nine unchanged audio inputs across five trials**. Median initialization fell from **1,370 ms to 590 ms**; text, tokens, and timestamps matched exactly. I’m keeping portable CPU graph fusion and rejecting the hardware-specific layout variant.

For the compact build, I’ll use **exclusive model phases**: VAD/diarization, then ASR, then LLM, releasing each before the next. This trades warm-session reuse for lower peak RAM; the prepared encoder offsets part of that reload cost. I also found model extraction running in `Application.onCreate`, so I’m moving it off the UI thread.

1	package team.mikcoders.neurosteno.pipeline
2	
3	import android.util.Log
4	
5	/**
6	 * Best-effort native load for sherpa-onnx Android AAR (libsherpa-onnx-jni.so).
7	 * Called at process start so UnsatisfiedLinkError is visible without a transcript run.
8	 */
9	object SherpaJni {
10	    const val LIBRARY = "sherpa-onnx-jni"
11	    private const val TAG = "SherpaJni"
12	
13	    data class Probe(val loaded: Boolean, val error: String?)
14	
15	    @Volatile
16	    var last: Probe = Probe(loaded = false, error = "not probed")
17	        private set
18	
19	    @Synchronized
20	    fun probe(): Probe {
21	        if (last.loaded) return last
22	        last = try {
23	            System.loadLibrary(LIBRARY)
24	            Log.i(TAG, "loaded lib$LIBRARY.so")
25	            Probe(loaded = true, error = null)
26	        } catch (t: UnsatisfiedLinkError) {
27	            Log.e(TAG, "UnsatisfiedLinkError loading $LIBRARY", t)
28	            Probe(loaded = false, error = t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName)
29	        } catch (t: Throwable) {
30	            Log.e(TAG, "native load failed", t)
31	            Probe(loaded = false, error = t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName)
32	        }
33	        return last
34	    }
35	}

1	package team.mikcoders.neurosteno.pipeline
2	
3	import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
4	import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineDispatcher
5	import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
6	import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
7	import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
8	import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
9	import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
10	import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
11	import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
12	
13	/**
14	 * One lazy native model, serialized transactions, no cached PCM or transcripts.
15	 *
16	 * Native calls cannot be preempted safely. Cancellation is observed between
17	 * calls; eviction/close wait for the owning transaction before freeing JNI.
18	 * Creation and destruction stay on [dispatcher], including teardown after the
19	 * caller is cancelled. A failed transaction invalidates possibly poisoned state.
20	 */
21	internal class InferenceSession<M : Any>(
22	    private val create: suspend () -> M,
23	    private val destroy: (M) -> Unit,
24	    private val dispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.Default,
25	) {
26	    private val mutex = Mutex()
27	    private val closed = AtomicBoolean(false)
28	    private var model: M? = null
29	
30	    /** [getModel] is valid only inside the transaction and must not escape it. */
31	    suspend fun <T> run(operation: suspend (getModel: suspend () -> M) -> T): T =
32	        withContext(dispatcher) {
33	            mutex.withLock {
34	                check(!closed.get()) { "Inference session is closed" }
35	                try {
36	                    currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
37	                    val result = operation {
38	                        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
39	                        // Publish ownership before observing cancellation of a
40	                        // suspending native load, so its handle is not lost.
41	                        val loaded = model ?: withContext(NonCancellable) { create() }
42	                            .also { model = it }
43	                        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
44	                        loaded
45	                    }
46	                    currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
47	                    result
48	                } catch (failure: Throwable) {
49	                    try {
50	                        discard()
51	                    } catch (cleanup: Throwable) {
52	                        failure.addSuppressed(cleanup)
53	                    }
54	                    throw failure
55	                }
56	            }
57	        }
58	
59	    /** Drop warm weights and dependent caches between complete transactions. */
60	    suspend fun evict(onEvict: suspend () -> Unit = {}) = withContext(dispatcher + NonCancellable) {
61	        mutex.withLock {
62	            try {
63	                discard()
64	            } finally {
65	                onEvict()
66	            }
67	        }
68	    }
69	
70	    /** Reject queued/new work and release once the active transaction finishes. */
71	    suspend fun close() {
72	        closed.set(true)
73	        withContext(dispatcher + NonCancellable) {
74	            mutex.withLock { discard() }
75	        }
76	    }
77	
78	    private fun discard() {
79	        val old = model
80	        model = null
81	        if (old != null) destroy(old)
82	    }
83	}

35	class SherpaStenoPipeline(
36	    private val paths: ModelPaths,
37	    private val llm: LocalLlmPostPass = HeuristicPunctuationPostPass(),
38	    private val scene: FarFieldScene = FarFieldScene.stage6,
39	) : StenoPipeline {
40	    override val displayName: String =
41	        when {
42	            paths.hasPrimaryAsr && scene.expectedSpeakers > 0 ->
43	                "sherpa zipformer-ru-int8 far-field ${scene.expectedSpeakers}spk"
44	            paths.hasPrimaryAsr -> "sherpa zipformer-ru-int8"
45	            paths.hasBackupAsr -> "sherpa whisper-tiny"
46	            else -> "sherpa (incomplete models)"
47	        }
48	    override val llmDisplayName: String = llm.displayName
49	    override val llmIsOnDevice: Boolean = llm.isOnDeviceLlm
50	
51	    private val inference = InferenceSession(
52	        create = { createRecognizer() },
53	        destroy = { it.release() },
54	    )
55	
56	    override suspend fun trimMemory() {
57	        inference.evict { llm.trimMemory() }
58	    }
59	
60	    override suspend fun close() {
61	        try {
62	            inference.close()
63	        } finally {
64	            llm.close()
65	        }
66	    }
67	
68	    override suspend fun transcribe(
69	        audio: PcmAudio,
70	        onProgress: (PipelineProgress) -> Unit,
71	    ): TranscriptFile = inference.run { getRecognizer ->
72	        val context = currentCoroutineContext()
73	        fun checkpoint() = context.ensureActive()
74	        require(audio.sampleRate == Pcm.TARGET_HZ) { "need 16 kHz PCM" }
75	        onProgress(PipelineProgress(PipelineStage.Decode, "PCM ${audio.samples.size} samples", 0.05f))
76	
77	        val hz = audio.sampleRate
78	        val staged = if (scene.expectedSpeakers > 0) {
79	            FarFieldGain.stage(audio.samples)
80	        } else {
81	            null
82	        }
83	        val work = if (staged != null) audio.copy(samples = staged.samples) else audio
84	        val energy = if (staged != null) {
85	            staged.segments.map { SpeechRegion(it.start, it.endInclusive + 1) }
86	        } else {
87	            FarFieldVad.speechRegions(work.samples, hz)
88	        }
89	        onProgress(
90	            PipelineProgress(
91	                PipelineStage.Vad,
92	                "energy windows ${energy.size} (gain/EQ frozen)",
93	                0.18f,
94	            ),
95	        )
96	        checkpoint()
97	        val silero = if (paths.hasVad) collectSilero(work, ::checkpoint) else emptyList()
98	        val regions = FarFieldVad.union(energy, silero)
99	
100	        val raw = if (paths.hasDiar) {
101	            onProgress(PipelineProgress(PipelineStage.Diarize, "OfflineSpeakerDiarization K=${scene.expectedSpeakers}", 0.25f))
102	            // Release segmentation/embedding sessions before loading the cold
103	            // ASR model. Subsequent calls may reuse one warm ASR model.
104	            val segments = diarize(work, regions)
105	            checkpoint()
106	            if (segments.isEmpty()) emptyList() else {
107	                transcribeSegments(work, segments, getRecognizer(), onProgress, ::checkpoint)
108	            }
109	        } else {
110	            onProgress(PipelineProgress(PipelineStage.Vad, "Silero VAD chunks", 0.25f))
111	            vadThenAsr(work, getRecognizer(), onProgress, ::checkpoint)
112	        }
113	        checkpoint()
114	        onProgress(PipelineProgress(PipelineStage.Llm, llm.displayName, 0.92f))
115	        val cleaned = llm.cleanup(raw)
116	        checkpoint()
117	        onProgress(PipelineProgress(PipelineStage.Done, "${cleaned.size} utterances", 1f))
118	        TranscriptFile(transcript = cleaned.sortedBy { it.startMs })
119	    }
120	
121	    private fun diarize(
122	        audio: PcmAudio,
123	        vadRegions: List<SpeechRegion>,
124	    ): List<DiarSeg> {
125	        val diar = createDiarizer()
126	        try {
127	            val segs = diar.process(audio.samples)
128	            val mapped = segs.map { s ->
129	                DiarSeg(
130	                    speakerIndex = s.speaker,
131	                    startMs = (s.start * 1000).toLong(),
132	                    endMs = (s.end * 1000).toLong(),
133	                )
134	            }
135	            return VadDiarReconcile.run(
136	                vadRegions,
137	                mapped,
138	                audio.sampleRate,
139	                scene,
140	                samples = audio.samples,
141	            )

```kotlin
internal suspend fun <Raw, Out> runExclusivePhases(
    asrPhase: suspend () -> Raw,
    releaseAsr: suspend () -> Unit,
    llmPhase: suspend (Raw) -> Out,
): Out {
    val raw = try { asrPhase() } finally { releaseAsr() }
    return llmPhase(raw)
}
```
On asr cancellation: finally releaseAsr (evict NonCancellable) runs, then cancellation propagates, llm skipped. Good. On success: release then llm. Peak = max not sum. 

Edge: releaseAsr throws on success path → llm skipped, error propagates. Acceptable (release failure is serious).
